label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
raw_output: When a company collects customer information, they must keep a record of how they handle that data, including who is involved and the purpose of the data collection. This applies to businesses that process personal data, such as when they take customer orders or send invoices.
